basics.name: Velmurugan Velayutham
basics.label: Technical Lead | Java | Spring Boot | ReactJS | NextJS | Cloud-Native Solutions
basics.summary: Results-driven Technical Lead with 14+ years of experience in web application development. Expert in Java 17, Spring Boot, and ReactJS, consistently delivering scalable, high-performance cloud-native solutions. Proven ability to lead and mentor teams (5-10 engineers), drive innovation, and optimize system reliability.

work.summary: Technical System Analyst at Juniper Networks leading full-stack development, cloud-native architectures, and team management for critical enterprise systems.
highlights: Led a 10-member engineering team in designing and delivering scalable microservices.
Championed critical system optimizations, achieving a 40% reduction in response times through Redis caching.
Achieved 99.9% system uptime by successfully migrating legacy systems to AWS cloud-native architectures.
Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Terraform, resulting in a 75% reduction in deployment time.
Proficient in ReactJS/NextJS for full-stack development and cloud-native architectures.
Optimized API Gateway integration, enabling support for large file uploads with S3 pre-signed URLs.
Boosted system reliability by 20% through proactive monitoring and root cause analysis.

work.summary: Worked as a Senior Full Stack Developer - Mobile Programming LLC., responsible for designing and implementing scalable web applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
highlights: Designed and implemented scalable web applications using ReactJS and Spring Boot frameworks.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Optimized application performance and ensured responsiveness across devices.
Participated in code reviews and provided mentorship to junior developers.

projects.name: SWDL - Software Downloads
projects.description: Customer facing applications to help download software packages and updates through Juniper Single Sign-On (SSO).
highlights: Facilitates legal and efficient software distribution by integrating with Juniper's internal systems for license validation and entitlement checks.
Validates customer IP addresses to ensure compliance.
Leverages Akamai CDN for accelerated content delivery.
Includes robust logging and reporting of download activity for comprehensive auditing.

projects.name: BAM
highlights: Provides real-time visibility and management of transactions across thousands of middleware interfaces (SAP, IBM, Oracle, Salesforce, etc.).
Empowers business teams to monitor transaction health, performance, and reprocess failed transactions.
Offers a unified dashboard for comprehensive insights.

projects.name: IP Validation Service
projects.description: IP address lookup and Geolocation service for Juniper's customer-facing applications.
highlights: Ensures legal compliance and regional access control by validating IP addresses against geolocation data (e.g., MaxMind DB) to identify origin and restrict access from embargoed countries.
Provides real-time feedback to users.
Integrates with all customer-facing applications for a seamless experience.
All validation requests are logged and centrally monitored using the ELK stack for auditing and reporting.
